description: Use when an agent has a name where it needs an address, or the other way round, before it can act: resolves an ENS name to its address or an address to its primary ENS name, read straight from Ethereum mainnet, with found telling you when there is no record. Do not use to check an address is well formed (/v1/util/address) or that it is a wallet (/v1/evm/is-contract). No API key. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

address.description: Address to reverse-resolve. Use instead of name.

name.description: ENS name to resolve, such as vitalik.eth.

name: evm_ens
title: ENS name resolution
